name: EPROD JIB Statement
description: Extract Joint Interest Billing (JIB) statements from JV operators with AFE references, working-interest split, capital + operating charges, and prior-period adjustments.

documentSchema.description: JIB schema covering statement identity, JV name, operator, AFE reference, billing period, working-interest math, capital + operating charges, partner share, prior-period adjustments, cumulative position, supporting invoices, and dispute window.
documentSchema.extractionInstructions: Capital and operating charges must be extracted separately. Every charge line must reference its AFE. Cumulative-to-date is required for AFE bounds checking.

jv_name.description: Joint venture name (e.g. Sweeny Frac, Mont Belvieu)

working_interest_pct.description: EPROD working interest percentage per JOA

capital_charges.description: Capital charge line items (description, gross_usd, afe_ref)

operating_charges.description: Operating charge line items (description, gross_usd, afe_ref)

gross_total.description: Total gross charges for the period

prior_period_adjustments.description: Prior-period adjustments with original billing cycle ref

cumulative_to_date.description: Cumulative AFE charges through this statement

dispute_period_deadline.description: Last date to file dispute (typically statement_date + 24 months)
